title: TEMSCO 산업 R&D 강도 기반 개발투자 분석 가정의 근거
status: 산업 R&D/Sales 직접 확보; 산업의 실제 회계상 개발비 자산화율 미확보

analystIllustration.capitalizationShareStatus: 20% illustrative analyst assumption, NOT observed industry ratio
20% illustrative analyst assumption, NOT observed industry ratio

sources.author: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern
sources.definition: Aggregated R&D expenses as percent of aggregated revenues across firms; not median individual firm ratio

sources.author: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern
sources.definition: R&D Capitalized is author estimate using five-year straight-line amortization, aggregated across firms; stock of reconstructed research asset, not period accounting development additions
Issuer index links Global margins and R&D workbooks

sources.vintage: 2022 issued standard; recognition distinction predates cutoff
sources.definition: Research expensed; development recognition only after applicable criteria; finite-life amortization. Not evidence of TEMSCO eligibility or a five-year mandatory useful life.

negativeFinding.scope: 이번 한정 조사에서 NYU Global margins/R&D 원본 및 IAS38 확인. BOK 또는 회계기준 일치 peer의 실제 자산화율 평균 확보 완료로 주장하지 않음
whyNYUNumberNotTheRatio: 자산화 연구자산은 누적 잔액 stock, 당기 개발비 자산화 지출은 flow
NYU는 모든 R&D의 경제적 자산 재구성을 위한 연구자 추정; 공시상 자산인식비중이 아님
자산화 R&D/투하자본은 R&D/매출 또는 당기개발비/총R&D와 다른 분모

recommendedAssumptionStructure.primarySelectionReason: 기존 WACC 전자부품 참고 분류와 일관된 broad proxy. TEMSCO 자체 실측비율 또는 순수 sputter/mask peer 평균 아님
recommendedAssumptionStructure.capitalizationShareMustBe: Explicit analyst assumption; example20% is illustrative only
recommendedAssumptionStructure.amortizationYearsStatus: NYU analytical convention, not observed TEMSCO useful life or mandatory accounting rule
recommendedAssumptionStructure.existingExpenseShareMustBe: Explicit fraction of modeled capitalized spending already expensed in source EBIT; not established by industry data
recommendedAssumptionStructure.applyRevenueScope: Consolidated external revenue after intercompany elimination
recommendedAssumptionStructure.doubleCountGuard: 기존 10억 R&D 자금사용 배분 및 계획 CAPEX의 5억 R&D 설비와 프로젝트별 대사; 5억 설비는 유형투자이며 개발비와 임의 중복가산 금지

symbols.e: fraction of C already expensed in source EBIT
symbols.A: new development amortization for current period

modelBridge.fcff: FCFF = EBIT_adjusted - cashOperatingTax + DA_adjusted - otherCAPEX - C - deltaNWC
modelBridge.pretaxInvariant: Delta(pre-tax FCFF) = -(1-e)*C; e=1 pure reclassification has zero pre-tax cash-flow impact
modelBridge.cashTax: Keep a separately justified cash-tax path; do not assume adjusted accounting EBIT*22% automatically reflects tax cash flows. Pure valuation reclassification alone must not change tax paid. Tax deductibility/timing unverified.
modelBridge.period: 2026 residual cash114/365 only as explicit even-spending assumption; historical amortization inventory and commissioning dates not verified
modelBridge.terminal: g=0 still requires recurring C. In fully mature steady state, A=C under constant spend; explicitly bridge first five years of cohort amortization before assuming steady state.
modelBridge.multiple: Capitalized-R&D-adjusted TEMSCO EBIT is not directly comparable to DNP reported EBIT. Preserve reported-basis Exit EBIT or adjust peer earnings under the identical policy; avoid mechanical valuation uplift.

limits: Current industry R&D is expensed reported R&D and may not cover all development spending already capitalized under different local standards
Electronics includes broader electronics; specialty chemicals includes businesses outside TEMSCO products; no arbitrary weighting into a fictitious pure-industry average
Industry values are aggregate ratios, not medians or selected profitable-peers only
Actual accounting capitalization eligibility, development completion dates, opening development assets, useful life and tax treatment remain unverified

adoptedAnalystAssumptions.capitalizationShareStatus: 분석 가정; 산업 실제 자산화율 아님
adoptedAnalystAssumptions.existingExpenseStatus: 기존 비용과 별도 추가 개발예산 가정; 중복 부재 확인 아님
adoptedAnalystAssumptions.tax: 장부상각과 세무공제 시점 일치 가정; 즉시 공제 및 크레딧 없음
adoptedAnalystAssumptions.fullyMatureTerminal: 매년 C지출 유지, A=C인 완전 비용부담 정상 EBIT 사용
